== About the Community Wiki ==

The '''Bohemia Interactive Community Wiki (Biki)''' is the up-to-date knowledge base related to all the [[Bohemia Interactive]] projects.<br>
It is [[Special:RecentChanges|always worked on]] and all members of the community are welcome to contribute to it. Do you want to contribute? See [[Bohemia Interactive Community:Getting Started|Getting Started]]!


== About Bohemia Interactive ==

[[Bohemia Interactive]] is the company behind the '''{{arma}}''' series and the '''{{GameCategory|dayz|link=y}}''', '''{{GameCategory|vigor|link=y}}''' and '''{{GameCategory|ylands|link=y}}''' brands. Full article: [[Bohemia Interactive]].
